tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde'i dbang pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya rat+na dha ra ni/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ nor phyugs skyong zhing spel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dpal ldan rnam thos sras dang ār+ya dzam bha lha la sogs pa/ nor lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus cig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang*/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dang*/ nor lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so// de'i tshe sa yi lha mo brtan mas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos smra ba'i dge slong de dag la sogs pa rnams/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir skye bo mang po la phan pa dang*/ skye bo mang po la bde ba'i phyir/ dbul zhing 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ phyug cing bde ba dang*/ bsam pa 'grub pa dang*/ nor dang rigs rgyud dar zhing 'phel ba dang*/ tshe rabs thams cad du longs spyod che zhing*/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo khyod kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa dang*/ bde ba'i phyir zhus pa legs so legs so// de'i phyir khyod legs par nyon cig /dang po bdag gi mdun du mgon po rnam thos sras sku mdog ser po/ phyag g.yas na rin po che'i dbyug to/ g.yon na ne'u le ser po sre mong gi rkyal pa nor gyis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ seng gel gdan byas pa/ btsun mo nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ dpal ldan ār+ya dzam bha la sku mdog mthing kha/ phyags g.yas na shing thog gi 'bras bu pun dza pu ra 'dzin pa/ g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor gyis bkang ba 'dzin pa/

dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ ut+pa la'i phreng bas se ral khar brgyan pa/ btsun mo nor bdag mo dang*/ nor lha chen po brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ phyugs lha ljang khu rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa phyag g.yas na rin po che'i gzhong pa mar gyis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon na shel gyi zo ba zhos bkang ba bsnams pa/ de ltar lha rnams mngon sum du dmigs la/ spos chab kyis maṇ+ḍal byas pa'i steng du me tog sil ma bkram/ pu dza rnam pa sna tshogs pas mchod/ de nas nor dang bsod nams 'phel bar byed pa'i gzungs 'di brjod do// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bai shra ma ṇā ya/ ma hā rā dzā ya/ tad+ya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsan ta tsan ta/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki li ki li/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sad dh+ya ad ma na ma/ nyid dh+ya na ad dha na/ tsan dha dhu swā hā/ na mo bai shra ma ṇā ye swā hā/ na mo ra ta pa ra pu ya swā hā/ gang gis gzungs 'di brjod pas tshe rabs thams cad du/ nor dang rigs brgyud dar zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ro// na mo bai shra ma ṇā ye swā hā/ na mo ār+ya dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo de ba dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo nā ga dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo yag sha dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo rag sha dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo sur+ya dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo pu tra tsan tra dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo sti thi dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ dha na ma dhe hi swā hā/ bdag la ba su de hi swā hā/ snying po de brjod pa'i mthus dge slong chos smra ba'i khyim du nor dang*/ 'bru dang*/ gser dang*/ g.yu dang*/ dngul dang*/ zangs dang*/ lcags dang*/ nor bu dang*/ mu tig dang*/ bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dung dang*/ byu ru dang*/ pun ḍa ri ka dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ in+da nī la dang*/ ke ke ra dang*/ dh+yi ka dang*/ kar sha pa ni dang*/ man shel dang*/ sa le sbraṃ dang*/ baiḍūr+ya dang*/

rta dang*/ glang po che dang*/ ma he dang*/ gnag dang*/ ba lang dang*/ ra lug dang*/ nas dang*/ 'bras dang*/ gro dang*/ khre dang*/ til dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ so ba dang*/ sran ma dang*/ byi til dang*/ mon sran dang*/ tshe rabs tham sa cad du nor phyugs 'phel bar 'gyur ro// 'byor tshad gtor mar bshams nas ni/ nor lha rnams la mchod gyur na/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di bzhes la// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// nor lha chen po khyed rnams kyis// bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'dzam gling gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// de bzhin dpal ldan ār+ya dzam bha la dang ni// rta bdag ku bhe ra dang lug bdag nor bu bzang*// gang ba bzang dang 'brog gnas lnga rtsen pi tsi kun ḍa li// phyugs lha ljang khu dang ni lha mo nor rgyun ma// rmugs 'dzin la sogs pho nya chen po brgyad/ nor lha'i tshogs rnams gtor ma phul ba 'di bzhes la// yon sbyor bdag la tshe rabs thams cad du// bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'dzam gling gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// nor lha chen po khyed rnams kyis// 'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan// sde po che la stobs po che// pha rol dpung ni 'joms par byed// gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che// rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing grags dang ldan// mi nad nor gyi god ka zlog par mdzod// lha dang mi ni skyong bar byed// bdag nyid chen po de dag la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bdag la tshe rabs thams cad du// bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'dzam gling gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// de nas sa'i lha mo brtan ma stan las langs nas/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis nor lha'i tshogs ni ji ltar sgom/

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa// nor lha sgom pa'i rim pa 'di ltar lags// dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rnam thos sras sku mdog ser po/ bai ser po las bskyed/ de'i spyan sngar ār+ya dzam bha lha sku mdog mthing ka /phyag g.yas na shing thog gi 'bras bu bsnams pa/ g.yon na ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor gyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ shar du smugs 'dzin/ lho na gang ba bzang po bum pa 'dzin pa/ nub na nor bu bzang po nor bu thogs pa/ byang du rta bdag ku be ra ral gri thogs pa/ mtshams bzhir yang dag shes ser po ral gri can/ 'brog gnas mdung thogs nas nor bsrung ba/ lnga rtsen ser skya rat+na'i khang bu brtsegs pa bsnams pa/ dzi bi kun ḍa li ral gri bsnams nas gnod byed zlog par byed pa/ de dag thams cad rta la chibs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa yum brgyad sku la 'khril ba/ gnod sbyin dang nor lha'i 'khor bye bas bskor ba/ g.yas thams cad du so so'i phyag mtshan 'phyar ba/ g.yon thams cad rta'i srab mda' bzung bar bsgom/ dzam bha lha'i yum nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon gyi 'bras kyi snye ma bzung ba/ rat+na'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rab tu mdzes pa'i cha byad can/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa na chung ma lta bu/ yum zla 'od ma dang*/ rab sbyin ma dang*/ 'phags ma dang*/ sbas ma dang*/ lha mo dbyangs can ma dang*/ de rnams kha dog yab dang 'dra ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas thams cad 'bras kyi snye ma bzung ba/ g.yon thams cad rin po che'i phreng ba 'dren pa/ rab tu mdzes pa'i cha byad can/ yab re la g.yon phyogs su yum re bsgom mo// de nas 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di rab tu 'don par byas nas/ de la spos kyang byug /me tog bsil mar bkram/ pu dza rnam pa lnga bsham/ mtshams drag tu bcad/ bdag nyid khrus legs par byas/ de nas nor lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa mdun du spyan drang nas/

gong ltar sgom zhing gzungs 'di brjod par bya'o// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bai shra ma ṇā ye swā hā/ ma hā ra dzā ya/ tad+ya thā/ si mi si mi/ su ru su ru/ tsan ta tsan ta/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki li ki li/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sadh+ya ad ma na ma nyid dh+ya na/ a dha na tsa ha/ ma hā swā hā/ na mo bai shra ma ṇā ye swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ na mo ār+ya dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo de ba dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo nā ga dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo yak+ṣa dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo rak+ṣa dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na mo sur+ya dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ na moḥ pu tra tsan+d+ra dzam bha lā ye swā hā/ bdag la ba su de hi/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ nor lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dbus na rgyal po rnam thos sras yab yum ser po/ shar na dzam bha la yab yum mthing kha/ lho na gang ba bzang po yab yum/ nub na nor bu bzang po yab yum/ byang na rta bdag ku bai ra yab yum/ shar lho mtshams na lug lha yang dag shes ser po yab yum/ lho nub mtshams na nor la 'brog gnas nag po yab yum/ nub byang mtshams na lnga rtsen ser skya yab yum/ byang shar mtshams na lug lha dzi bi kun ḍa li dkar po yab yum/ yang dbus na phyugs lha ljang khu/ gzhan yang lha chen po'i nor lha dang*/ klu chen po'i nor lha dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi nor lha dang*/ srin pa'i nor lha dang*/ tshangs pa'i nor lha dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i nor lha dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi nor lha dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi nor lha dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nor lha dang*/ nor lha'i tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal nas/ thams cad du phun sum tshogs nas/ nor dang*/ 'bru dang*/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ zangs lcags dang*/ dung dang*/ byu ru dang*/

bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ pun ḍa ri ka dang*/ pad+ma rā ga dang*/ in+d+ra ni la dang*/ ke ke ru dang*/ tir ya ka dang*/ kar sha pa ni dang*/ man shel dang*/ sa le sbram dang*/ rta dang glang po che dang*/ ma he dang*/ gnag dang*/ ba lang dang*/ ra lug dang*/ nas dang*/ gro dang*/ 'bras dang*/ til dang*/ so ba dang*/ sran ma dang*/ khre dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ mon sran dang*/ nor phyugs dang*/ yo byad thams cad kyi char chen po phob cig /dkon mchog mchod pa'i yo byad/ chos spyod pa'i mthun rkyen/ bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ bdag la ba su puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru dhe hi/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'don zhing*/ nor lha mchod gyur na/ tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du/ sems can dmyal ba dang*/ byol song gi skye gnas dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du nam yang skye bar mi 'gyur ro// nam du yang mi khom par skye bar mi 'gyur ro// gang du skye ba'i skye ba dran par 'gyur ro// gang zhig tshe zad pa las/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di 'don na tshe yang rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro// sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam yang byang bar 'gyur ro// de dag la bdud dang bdud kyi rigs kyi lha dang klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ sha za rnams kyi glags btsal kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro// gal te dus la babs te 'chi bar gyur na yang*/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus mngon sum du lung ston par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas stong gi de la phyag rkyong bar 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro// 'di la the tshom dang som nyi dang*/ yid gnyis ma za zhig /rgyal po chen po bzhi yang de'i phyi bzhin 'brangs nas srung ba dang*/ bde ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ sbed par byed do// sa phyogs gang du mdo sde dkon mchog 'di 'bri'am/

klog gam kha ton du 'don na/ sa phyogs de yang mchod rten du 'gyur ro// phyag bya bar 'os par gyur to/ byol song gi skye gnas su song ba'i tshe na bya dang ri dwags kyi rna lam du sgra grag par gyur na yang*/ de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// de dag mir skyes na yang rgyal rigs su skye bar 'gyur ro// gzugs bzang bar 'gyur ro// dbyangs snyan par 'gyur ro// shes rab che bar 'gyur ro// chos spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// zad pa med pa'i longs spyod ni tshe rabs kun tu rnyed par 'gyur ro// khyad par du rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dang*/ de bzhin ār+ya dzam bha la dang rta bdag ku be ra/ phyugs bdag lha mo nor rgyun ma dang*/ lug bdag nor bu bzang po dang*/ de la sogs te nor lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis tshe rabs rtag tu grogs byed par 'gyur ro// de skad ces bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa dang*/ de nas de'i tshe lha mo dpal stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa cig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// btsun pa bcom ldan 'das yon tan de dag dang ldan pa lags na/ gser 'od 'don zhing nor lha mchod gyur na/ grub pa'i mtshan ma ji ltar lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha mo dpal legs par nyon cig /ngas khyod la bshad do// gser 'od 'don zhing nor lha mchod gyur na/ grub pa'i mtshan ma 'di ltar lags// bdag gis gter dang nor bskungs rnyed// gser dang shing 'bras 'thu ba dang*// zhing rmo lo thog brnga ba dang*// snye ma gsil dang 'bru bdag byed// bang khang 'bru dang nor gyis gang*// pho mo rab tu bzang po yis// bza' btung nor 'bru la sogs sbyin// bu mo bag ma bzang mo yis// gro phye chang dang 'o ma blud// dkar gsum byin dang dus byed dang*/

nor phyugs mang po bdag byed dang*// dmag mi khrab can dpon po bya ru can/ ma ral gyon pa'i dmag tshogs kyis// tswa dang sog dang lo ma sbyin// de dag grub pa'i mtshan ma lags// grub pa'i mtshan ma byung gyur na/ bdag gi nor dang rigs brgyud da ra// bsams pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/ lha mo chen mo dpal dang*/ lha dang mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las/ tshe rabs thams cad du yo byad phun sum tshogs pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa rdzogs so/// /maṅga laṃ//
